name: Are there any upfront costs associated with a sale-leaseback?

mainEntity.name: Are there any upfront costs associated with a sale-leaseback?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, similar to a traditional home sale, you can expect some upfront costs in a sale-leaseback transaction. These may include closing costs, title fees, and potentially real estate commissions, though some investors might cover certain fees. It's important to get a detailed breakdown of all potential expenses before committing. Kelby Contreras helps prepare clients by outlining the typical costs involved, allowing for a clear understanding of the net proceeds you can expect from the sale in advance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, sale-leaseback transactions involve upfront costs like closing fees and commissions, similar to traditional sales.
